poll_interval_ms.label: Poll interval (ms)
poll_interval_ms.description: How often to read agent state from herdr.

socket_path.label: herdr socket path
socket_path.description: Leave empty for the default herdr session. Set it to watch a server started with HERDR_SOCKET_PATH.

spinner_interval_ms.label: Working spinner speed (ms)
spinner_interval_ms.description: How often the working-agent spinner advances a frame. Lower is faster but redraws the panel more often while a panel is open.
